items.name: Finsupp.comapDomain_single
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} [inst : Zero M] (f : α → β) (a : α) (m : M)
  (hif : Set.InjOn f (f ⁻¹' ↑(Finsupp.single (f a) m).support)),
  Finsupp.comapDomain f (Finsupp.single (f a) m) hif = Finsupp.single a m
